stories.summary: The flow of private equity into India’s healthcare sector could increase treatment costs for patients without clear regulations, according to KPMG. stories.title: Bangladesh garment strikes offer opening for India
stories.summary: Wage strikes have halted production at about 690 Bangladeshi garment factories during the peak ordering season. Workers are demanding a monthly minimum wage of $241, up from $125. As Western retailers place their heaviest orders now, the industry is looking for alternatives. India is currently positioned to respond.

stories.title: Passenger vehicle registrations jump 93.6 percent
stories.summary: India's automobile industry saw double-digit growth in the second quarter of FY2027, according to Deloitte. Passenger vehicle wholesale volumes rose 30.7 percent to 1.4 million units, while commercial vehicle volumes increased 28.8 percent. Electric two-wheeler penetration has now crossed 11 percent, suggesting that range is finally a priority.
